item.title: Apple's Studio Display XDR Supports DICOM Medical Imaging for Diagnostic Radiology
item.description: The new Studio Display XDR is designed for all kinds of professional work, and it is uniquely suited for use in the medical field. item.description: OpenAI today updated its most popular ChatGPT model, debuting GPT-5.3 Instant.
